messages:
oliver: Heads up folks   Market St at Embarcadero is pouring again and some buskers set up right where the temporary detour narrowed the lane. 104a6 min delay for outbound buses. Also: someone lost a poncho to the wind. 
rina: Wait is this the trumpet guy who parks on the corner? He is iconic but also v loud. 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Muni outbound buses delayed ~8-12 min near Market/Embarcadero due to congestion and standing water. Expect reroutes. Ferry service: normal. 
joel: Yup trumpet guy. I admire the hustle but he basically turned the bike lane into an audience zone. Nearly got clipped. 
maya: Poll: poncho brigade check 3f9 React with :umbrella: if you kept umbrella, :thumbsup: if you have a poncho in bag, :wave: if you switched to scooter, :bus: if bus it was. 
oliver: :wave: scooter to skirt the crowd. Faster but soggy knees. 
rina: :umbrella: rescue umbrella survived, barely. 
joel: :thumbsup: got a tiny emergency poncho in laptop sleeve. Protip: compression band keeps it neat. 
maya: also FYI 2nd St boarded up storefront has a trickle into sidewalk 4a6 avoid the puddle there or your shoes will protest. 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Caltrain: on-time. BART: delays not reported. City traffic cameras show slow moving on Mission near Embarcadero. 
joel: anyone see the lost poncho? I heard someone tried to chase it and became a temporary performance act. 
rina: That would be trumpet guy's opening number. 
maya: If you find one, drop it at reception. I'll stigmatize my office's poncho stash with a sticky note. 
oliver: thanks for the heads up. heading into SoMa via 3rd instead. Also, trumpet guy played a surprisingly good rendition of "Singin' in the Rain" as we shimmied past. :notes:
